name: TSH Resources Berhad
overview: TSH Resources Berhad 在2026年完成了对 PT Dinamika Alam Segar 和 Konsep Majureka Sdn Bhd 的收购，扩大了种植业务；同时每月公布棕油、橡胶和木材产量，运营保持正常。最新一季营收同比下降6.6%，净利润同比增长6.7%。
overview_en: TSH Resources Berhad completed the acquisitions of PT Dinamika Alam Segar and Konsep Majureka Sdn Bhd in 2026, expanding its plantation business; meanwhile, it continued to report monthly production of palm oil, rubber and timber, with operations remaining normal. Latest quarter revenue decreased 6.6% year-on-year, while net profit increased 6.7%.

segments.name: 棕油产品
segments.note: 今年完成对 PT Dinamika Alam Segar 和 Konsep Majureka Sdn Bhd 的收购，扩大种植业务；每月公布棕油和棕仁产量。
segments.note_en: Completed acquisitions of PT Dinamika Alam Segar and Konsep Majureka Sdn Bhd this year, expanding plantation business; monthly production of CPO and palm kernel reported.

actions.text: 上述收购已于2026年7月3日完成。
actions.text_en: The above acquisitions were completed on 3 July 2026.
